mentl/6c51e46:
The prior landing named the row gap from the wheel's own check
verdicts; this digs it to the root rather than guessing at the crown's
algebra. Minimal repro banked unregistered: a fn declaring Cast plus
!Mutate over a mutually-recursive !Mutate callee is refused by its own
declaration, on check and compile and the blob alike. Four theories
killed in order — bare-vs-instance passes alone, negation-beside-
positives passes, a non-recursive callee passes, mutual recursion is
the discriminator. The root is row_without_self: it takes the least
solution of a recursive row equation but cuts SELF-only, so a tail
landing on a co-member's handle never cuts and the row never closes.
The fix is the same argument one scope up — the cut belongs to the
binding group — and its scope is measured: the cut fires where only
nesting frames are visible, and the rounds re-judge in layer order
without group context, so a trial-only fix would be undone. Banked
whole with the artifact that starts it.

mentl/6c3efb4:
The adversarial pass had me over-cave: §1 read "the medium does not cut out
the proposer... finding the intended program stays the proposer's job," ceding
the ranking to a learned model as a necessity. That models the wrong problem —
the FlashFill case of a bare type and a few examples, where a statistical prior
is needed to pin one of 10^20 consistent programs.

At the cursor the proposer sees the whole typed graph: every in-scope row, the
Reason chains carrying upstream intent, ownership, refinements, proximity. That
is a prior — structural, not statistical, and richer at the cursor than a
model's token-window. Generation is type/effect/ownership/refinement-directed
search over the finite in-scope vocabulary, pruned by the proof during the
search, which a token-sampler cannot do. For the next move the medium is the
best proposer and the learned model is unnecessary, not merely filtered: when
two survivors satisfy every expressed constraint, the medium surfaces the one
disambiguating refinement/type/example rather than guessing. A learned ranker
survives only as an optional last-resort Synth handler.

The honest boundary is scope: the next move, not a 500-line algorithm from one
sentence (underdetermined for search and model alike). §1 and §5 now say the
medium is the best next-move proposer with the model unnecessary at that scope,
keeping the refuter's surviving points — proof is a filter not a generator, a
partially-sound gate beats a fluent generator.

substrate-honest prelude verbs:

   `++` accumulator over capability-expansion variants per element.

   with two-acc threading.

8. infer_pat_record_subs — for_each over zip(flds, specs).
9. infer_pat_tuple — for_each with fresh sub-h mint per element.
10. bind_pcon_subpats — for_each over zip(params, sub_pats).

12. record_field_handles — map projecting handle per field value.

perennials/6cfac29:
Back no longer loses her place. ScrollToTop keyed on pathname, which changes on
a pop too, so closing a plant threw away her scroll and reset the list to the
first 48 of 300 -- and that is the loop she is in all day. The scroll is
restored on a pop and `limit` moved up into SearchProvider, which does not
unmount on navigation. Reset now happens during render rather than in an
effect, so a facet tap no longer mounts several hundred cards and immediately
unmounts all but 48 of them.

Guild view. "Show all 1,986" meant exactly that: one tap mounted 1,986 cards in
a single commit and froze the tab. It reveals a page at a time now. Its empty
layers used to say "loosen a constraint to fill it" -- but Ground cover is
recorded for 8 plants in the entire catalogue and Roots for 28, so no
constraint she could remove would ever fill them. Say which silence it is. And
the 4,149 plants with no recorded layer are no longer truncated to 24 behind a
summary that promises all of them.

Absence. The plant page never showed attracts, bloom colour or bloom period, so
she could narrow to "Attracts: Bees", tap a result, and read nothing about bees
-- unable to tell "nothing visits it" from "nobody looked". All three are on the
page now, and the two that are partially covered say so when they are blank.
Castor bean is marked edible with no edible parts recorded, one of about a
hundred like that, and the caution callout now says so instead of letting an
unqualified "Edible" stand beside a poison warning.

Offline. Every image now runs through one component that falls back to the ✿ on
a failed fetch, not only on a missing URL -- the image cache holds 1,500 of
4,736 photos, so in the field the fetch is what fails. The error state stopped
printing "Failed to fetch" and telling her to reload an installed PWA that has
no reload button; it asks navigator.onLine and offers a retry.
